purpose: Global discovery with market-specific purchase eligibility for affiliate and referral offers.
principles: Do not reject an otherwise relevant affiliate or merchant solely because its checkout or delivery territory is limited to one or more countries.
Separate global discovery visibility from local purchase eligibility: a product may be discoverable worldwide while its purchase CTA is enabled only for supported customer markets.
Treat publisher eligibility, customer delivery territory, product availability, and legal/compliance restrictions as separate fields; one must never be inferred from another.
For every offer, disclose the actual supported customer countries/regions, shipping or service limitations, currency, and any material restrictions before the outbound click.

If the visitor is outside the merchant's supported market, keep the listing discoverable where useful but disable or replace the purchase CTA with a clear unavailable-in-your-region notice; never imply delivery is possible.
Where multiple affiliate partners sell the same or equivalent product in different markets, select the partner whose verified territory serves the visitor, preserving that partner's own tracking URL.
Allow region-specific variants and offers for the same product identity; do not merge prices, availability, warranties, shipping terms, or tracking links across markets.
Do not publish a product offer until partner approval, tracking attribution, product data, image rights, and applicable market restrictions are verified.

marketSelection.visitorCountrySource: Use a reliable visitor-selected country or permitted coarse geolocation; allow manual country override.
priority: Exact country-specific partner offer with verified availability
Regional partner offer whose documented coverage includes the visitor country
Global partner offer with explicitly verified delivery/service to the visitor country
marketSelection.noEligibleOffer: Keep discovery listing only if it remains accurate and useful; suppress purchase action and clearly state that no verified seller currently serves the visitor's country.

safetyAndCompliance: Respect advertiser terms, local laws, sanctions, export controls, product restrictions, age restrictions, and platform/network policies.
Never bypass a merchant's geo-block, checkout restriction, or shipping policy.
Do not promise a commission, sale, delivery, warranty, or return outcome that has not been verified.
